name: Invalid Comparison
hint: Some of the comparisons compare attributes of different types.
instruction: Check your comparison and change one of the values. You can only compare numbers with numbers and text with text.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <(x position) > [twenty]> then :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
change (score v) by (1)
end
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <(x position) > (20)> then :: #007000 //⇦  👍
change (score v) by (1)
end
end
